# StrongFirst Switzerland

> > Official Swiss hub for StrongFirst strength training: kettlebell, barbell, and bodyweight certifications and workshops led by Pavel Tsatsouline's methodology.

StrongFirst Switzerland organizes instructor certifications (SFG I, SFG II), advanced workshops (Kettlebell 301, Simple & Sinister), and open training days across Swiss cities including Baden, St-Aubin, Geneva, and Bern. The site features a directory of certified instructors and maintains content in both English and French for Switzerland's multilingual community.

## Key Topics

- StrongFirst methodology
- Pavel Tsatsouline
- Kettlebell training
- SFG I & II certifications
- Barbell training
- Bodyweight training
- Instructor certification
- Simple & Sinister program
- Rite of Passage
- Beast Tamer challenge
- Iron Maiden Challenge
- Swiss fitness events
- Strength conditioning
- Advanced workshops

- [The School of Strength | StrongFirst Switzerland](https://strongfirst.ch): Homepage for StrongFirst Switzerland kettlebell, barbell & bodyweight training
- [The School of Strength | StrongFirst Switzerland (FR)](https://strongfirst.ch/fr): French homepage with Open Day 2026 in Baden and training programs
- [StrongFirst Certified Instructors](https://strongfirst.ch/instructors): Directory of StrongFirst certified instructors across Switzerland
